# Daily Briefing – Friday 17 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 3,270 steps and 2,289 kcal burned, virtually matching your target. That's fine; rest days have their place, though nudging those steps up would help keep momentum ticking over.

Your recovery picture looks genuinely strong. HRV at 112ms sits comfortably within your 101–119ms baseline, resting HR is an impressive 48bpm, and stress at 29/100 is low. Your body is telling you it's ready — don't waste that green light. Go ahead with today's planned session as intended.

With yesterday's calories almost spot-on but a rest day behind you, make sure you hit that 175g protein target today — it's easy to undereat protein on low-activity days and carry that deficit forward. Prioritise a solid protein source at every meal and you'll be set.
